prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ultra-wide 3:1 illustrated header for the top of the Tactics Guru GitHub README.
Primary request: Create polished original fantasy tactics key art grounded in this project's canonical heroes, isometric terrain and visual design. This is promotional illustration, not a gameplay screenshot.
Input images: Image 1 is a reference sheet for canonical hero silhouettes, equipment, faces and illustrated art style; do not reproduce the sheet or its labels. Image 2 is a title lettering style reference only; create fresh clean lettering.
Scene/backdrop: mossy forest ruins, olive foliage, weathered stone steps and grass arranged as a visible isometric diamond-grid battlefield, cool midnight shadows and restrained warm light; far-right terrain subtly transitions to sandy desert ruins, reflecting the game's Forest and Desert encounters.
Subject: exactly the three canonical heroes in a small party: blond Fighter in blue-and-gold tabard and steel armor with sword and blue/gold shield, brown-haired Ranger with olive hood and leather armor carrying bow/quiver, young Mage with blue-and-gold pointed hat and robes carrying a blue-jewel staff. A small pair of goblins can wait across the board. Tactical storytelling, confident adventure, readable silhouettes.
Style/medium: richly painted fantasy strategy-game cover art, detailed illustrated characters and tactile terrain, cohesive restrained polish, not pixel art, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: very wide 3:1 landscape banner; calm dark left half for large readable two-line title; hero party and isometric forest battlefield in the right half with foreground depth. Keep all lettering comfortably inside safe margins. The title must remain legible at GitHub README width. A single small compass/star ornament can sit above the title.
Lighting/mood: atmospheric twilight with warm rim light, inviting and adventurous.
Color palette: midnight navy #101827, olive foliage, parchment ivory #fff1cf, restrained brass #f0cf83 and aged gold, teal tactical highlights.
Text (verbatim): "TACTICS GURU" only, two lines, balanced classical serif capitals in ivory with thin gold edges and navy separation, inspired by Cinzel Semibold.
Constraints: no subtitle, no UI panels, no badges, no fake screenshot, no additional text, no watermark, no dragons or extra hero classes, no excessive bloom or ornamental clutter. Output one finished opaque banner.
